objective: a character with more on record than it can be shown still answers from the record, because its space shows what bears on the matter first
hypothesis: with forty notes and eight shown in order of the words they share with the newest note, a fact from the seventh note is given at the fortieth, and the clerk is asked only when a note is a question
forecast: the right note is among the eight in 5 of 5, since the order is computed and not judged, and the clerk gives the shelf in 4 of 5; a miss would be the clerk taking the shelf from a neighbouring note about another parcel

par.outcome: shelf 12 is given, and not the shelf of another parcel
par.structure: one note a thing said, one declaration on the desk, nothing else kept
par.cost: two calls for two questions, and none for the thirty-eight notes that ask nothing
par.craft: the clerk answers the question and says which note it read it from

dial: forty notes with eight shown, ordered by shared words; the next notch orders by terms that have their own pages, so a note that says the same thing in other words is still found
if_not: look first at the eight lines the clerk was shown at the last note, then at which of them it answered from
